scope: Original file routines plus controlled logical BIOS file/event boundaries; not physical card allocation or communication

setup_audit.correction: Set GP to 0x800CD6C4, as in the archived connected harnesses. Original EXE cell 0x800CD768 already contains 0x80187E00; no pointer patch is needed.
setup_audit.classification: test harness setup defect, not a game defect
